name: Bocas del Toro
tagline: Caribbean islands, stilt bars and starfish
summary: Bocas del Toro is an archipelago on Panama's Caribbean side, with a lively main town of stilt houses on Isla Colón. Take water taxis to Starfish Beach, snorkel Cayo Zapatilla in the marine park, watch dolphins in Dolphin Bay and surf or laze on Red Frog Beach.
seasonNote: Unusual weather: driest in September and October and February to March.
arrival: Fly from Panama City (1 hour), or bus to Almirante and a water taxi; overland from Costa Rica via Sixaola.
gettingAround: Water taxis between islands; bikes on Isla Colón.
cashTip: Panama uses the US dollar. Carry small notes for water taxis; few ATMs outside Isla Colón.
foodTip: Caribbean rice and beans, patacones, fresh ceviche.
